messages:
olivia: Heads-up team: we detected a subtle embeddings shift in host-prod for partner-lane B that started ~02:00 PT. Impact: ~0.7% drift in rerank scores for heavy queries. Rolling an emergency train tomorrow 06:30 PT to push a micro-rollback + calibration. Need eyeballs on canary. @eng-sre @qa-lead @docs

jamal: Thanks. Can you confirm whether this is model-side or infra-side? Any sign of quantization delta?

olivia: Initial triage points to a quant-plugin change from last week's deploy that altered scales for one layer in gpt-open-embed. We're planning to revert that change in the quick path and run calibration post-rollback.

release-bot: Emergency train created: train_id=rt-emer-1793337777, start=1793340600, steps=[15,40,100], canary_duration=15m, notify=@eng-releases

eng-sre: Oncall will prioritize embedding drift dashboards and signing checksums for model weights. Alert rule: embedding_cos_sim_drop > 0.5% over baseline triggers S2. We'll hold autoscale changes during canary.

ritu: Will prepare a short rollback bundle: `bundle: revert-quant-v2, run: embed-calibrate --baseline=prod-2026-03-20 --checks=cos_sim,vector_norm`. ETA for artifacts: 25m.

deploy-bot: Canary scheduled: train=rt-emer-1793337777, lanes=[hosted,dedicated], initial_traffic=15%, eu-first=false

qa-lead: QA plan: run rerank_accuracy_suite and partner-B smoke with 1k sample queries. We'll post quick-pass or fail within 20m of canary start. Focus on top-5 ordering stability.

docs: Preparing a short internal blurb and external partner note template. If we rollback, we'll send the partner note: "We observed an embeddings quality regression impacting rerank for a subset of queries; we've reverted the recent quant change and are monitoring. No data loss."

jamal: If we see non-reproducible diffs, escalate to model-ops. Also keep an eye on latency; the revert should not increase p95 beyond 300ms.

olivia: Rollout rules: 15% -> 40% -> 100%, 15m canary windows. Auto-rollback thresholds: embedding_cos_sim_drop >= 0.5% OR top5_reorder_rate >= 1.0% OR p95_latency > 300ms. Manual-hold if QA flags token continuity.

eng-sre: We'll set a 2h post-rollout observation window with elevated sampling for partner-B. If anything drifts, run `./deploy rollback --train rt-emer-1793337777 --reason "embed-drift"` and notify #incidents.

olivia: TL;DR: emergency train tomorrow 06:30 PT to revert quant-plugin tweak, 15% canary windows, QA + eng-sre watch, partner comms ready. Action owners: olivia (lead), jamal (model-ops), ritu (build), qa-lead (tests), eng-sre (ops), docs (comms). Ping me in thread for preflight checks. :fire:

jamal: I'll be online for the start. Adding a final preflight checklist 30m prior.

olivia: Thanks all — will post readiness 30m before start.
